summary: Full backend + frontend testing of CLOBA Arcade (Nailing / Plum / Ninja). Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed - POST /api/scores (new-best/no-update/higher/plum/ninja/unknown-400/empty-player/negative-clamp) and GET /api/leaderboard/{game} (sorted desc, unknown-400, no _id leak, per-game listing). Frontend: home hub renders 3 game cards, player-chip edit + name-input + save-name-button persist name (verified in leaderboard row 'TEST_UI_Player (you)'). Navigated to /game/nailing, /game/plum, /game/ninja - play-button starts each, HUD/testIDs appear, PanResponder drag increments taps-pill (1 tap registered), pause-button opens pause-overlay with resume-button. Plum wrong-tap triggered game-over-overlay (Game Over + NEW BEST + Rank + Home/Retry). Ninja idling-in-gap triggered game-over-overlay (score 131, rank #1). Leaderboard tab: leader-tab-nailing/plum/ninja all present; switching to Plum shows the submitted TEST_UI_Player row - end-to-end score submission is working.

issues: Deprecation warnings only on RN-Web preview (do not affect UX): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), useNativeDriver not supported on web (JS fallback). Native builds are unaffected.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace deprecated RN-Web style props to silence warnings: swap shadow* props for boxShadow (or gate via Platform.select), and move `pointerEvents` from prop to style.pointerEvents in game screens and overlays.
No functional fixes required - all requested features work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id (projection {_id:0}) and validates VALID_GAMES; empty-player becomes Anonymous; negative scores clamped to 0. Solid.
src/api.ts correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; failures fall back gracefully (null / []).
useGameSession.finish updates local best BEFORE awaiting network - good UX; submitScore failures are silently tolerated (acceptable, but a toast would be nicer).
Game loops re-render via setTick each frame - fine for this scope; refs prevent extra re-render cost.

All interactive elements have proper testID coverage (game-card-*, name-input, save-name-button, play-button, pause-button, pause-overlay, resume-button, game-over-overlay, game-over-home-button, game-over-retry-button, taps-pill, score-pill, score-value, jump-area, peach-button, plum-button, leader-tab-*).
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral leaderboard entries: TEST_nail_<uuid8>, TEST_plum_<uuid8>, TEST_ninja_<uuid8>, plus a UI-driven 'TEST_UI_Player' row in each game the UI test finished. Prefixed with TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Backend has only POST /api/scores and GET /api/leaderboard/{game} - both covered in test_arcade_api.py. If re-running xdist in parallel, use `-o addopts=` to disable it (session-scoped fixtures don't share across xdist workers). For UI, note that PanResponder drag in nailing needs a mouse down + progressive move down (not a single click). Plum game-over is triggered by tapping the wrong button. Ninja game-over is easily triggered by not tapping (falls in a gap after starting platform ends).
